integrity: The elliptic integral, the boundary extremizer, rigidity and quantitative trace stability have a self-contained support-function proof; finite numerical quadrature supplements but does not certify the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Centered planar ellipse, centered harmonic maps conformal only at the origin; the 2026 source manuscript was abstract-only accessible, so priority risk remains; independent validation has not occurred.
title: Sharp conformal central derivative and quantitative rigidity for harmonic maps into ellipses
